# Hooks

Each entry is a filter or action fired by `packages/theme-core/src`. Arguments are listed in callback order; filters receive the filtered value first. Hook names are governed by `docs/spec/naming-registry.json`.

- `joo/assets/register` — Action; arguments: `$assetRegistry`.
- `joo/assets/runtime_config` — Filter; arguments: `$value`.
